claims.text: Pityrosporum folliculitis: systemic therapy with oral antifungals is often the treatment of choice
claims.quote: Pityrosporum Folliculitis - systemic therapy with oral antifungal agents, is often the treatment of choice for this condition.

claims.text: Itraconazole and fluconazole are the two treatments of choice
claims.quote: Itraconazole and fluconazole are the two treatments of choice for this condition.
Although topical antifungals are an option, the belief is that systemic therapy can’t eliminate the Malassezia fungus deeper within the follicle than can topical therapies.
